content.comment_body: Hi, I have a question. When I am at home, I can access web control using IP 192.168.8.1, but what options are available to connect remotely when I am not at home?

Hi, To access the device remotely, you need to make it available to the public. This can be done by setting up a VPN connection or assigning a public IP/DNS to the device. This topic has been discussed multiple times on the forum; you may find useful information by searching previous threads. Regards
If you want to connect from outside your home network, you should use port forwarding on your router.
Thanks, but is there an easier way? For instance, is there a mobile app available?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges when trying to access remote web control for their [company_name] device. Recommendations from the community focus on networking setups such as VPN or port forwarding, which require technical configuration. The lack of a dedicated mobile application for remote access adds to user frustration, revealing a gap between what the product currently offers and what users expect in terms of easy remote connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a simple solution to access web control remotely, preferably through an official mobile app that does not require complex networking configuration.
